description: Persistent plug-and-play MCP activity dashboard for the owner's exact Ditoo Plus; Runtime 002 adds telemetry-only live session observability.

build.host_note: Runtime 002 changes WSL supervisor telemetry only; existing typed activity-session Host bytes and transport behavior are unchanged.

session.renewal: fresh unique Host session after lifetime/budget; displayed frame persists across brief socket rollover

behavior.collector_ownership: product runtime collects while connected and while backing off; standalone collector timer is transactionally disabled and restored on uninstall

install.startup_boundary: Windows user logon / StartWhenAvailable; WSL is user-scoped, so this is the reliable Windows startup boundary

authority.grant_scope_requested: Persistent unattended OpenDitoo MCP dashboard product runtime on exact Ditoo 11:75:58:CE:DE:C7 / firmware v42012 only; start automatically at Windows user logon; automatically reconnect after Host/device/Bluetooth unavailability with bounded backoff; after a physical input invalidates the canvas, immediately open a fresh bounded session and restore the MCP dashboard; collect the three configured MCP activity sources; use only the existing typed activity-session Host surface with one ACK per frame, 150 ms Host pacing floor and 200 ms nominal client cadence; no raw send, target override, generic Bluetooth operations, firmware/persistent device writes, command enumeration, pipelining, or OpenTivoo changes. Authority persists until explicit uninstall/revocation. Runtime 002 additionally permits telemetry-only state updates after successful Host open/frame ACK; this does not change transport bytes, pacing, reconnect/reclaim policy, or device operations.
authority.revocation: runtime/wsl/install_openditoo_product.sh --uninstall stops/disables product service, restores prior collector state, and moves a revoked policy record under .openditoo-local/revoked/
